tools.name: search_furniture
tools.description: Finds furniture in the catalog by words such as bed, sofa or table, and by size such as w:1200. Use the item keys with plan.furniture and plan.against.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Use this when someone mentions one of their plans or asks what plans they have. Lists the plans in their account with titles, floors and last changes, newest first.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to design, draw or plan a house, apartment, office, room or floor plan, and no plan of theirs fits. Starts a new empty plan to scale in their account and returns its ID. Build it with edit_project and show it with open_editor; do not describe a design in words or generate

tools.name: rename_project
tools.description: Changes the name of a plan in the person's account.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently deletes one plan from the person's account. It cannot be restored. Call this only for a plan that the person named in words. When they name none, as in "delete my plans", do not call this: call list_projects, show the titles and ask which ones to delete.

tools.name: describe_plan
tools.description: Facts that the planner computes for the site and for a floor or every floor: the site's location, time zone and north, rooms with areas and sizes, what each door connects, window directions, routes from the entrance, and warnings.

tools.name: query_project
tools.description: Runs a read-only script for questions that describe_plan does not answer, and returns what it returns. Scripts work as in edit_project, but only plan.floors, plan.elements, plan.get, plan.describe, plan.warnings, plan.check and plan.search are available; plan.check("din18040-2") or plan.check("irc20

tools.name: edit_project
tools.description:
Changes a plan with a short script of plan operations, which the person's open editors show at once. Returns the IDs that changed, the warnings and a description of every floor. A change is never final: undo_change takes it back and restores what it removed, for the last 50 changes.

tools.name: undo_change
tools.description: Takes back your own last change to a plan. The person's own edits stay as they are.

tools.name: redo_change
tools.description: Makes again your own last change to a plan. The person's own edits stay as they are.

tools.name: open_editor
tools.description: Shows a plan in the Simple House Planner editor, where the person can change it by hand in 2D and 3D and sees your changes as you make them. Without a project ID it shows their plans to choose from.

tools.name: account_profile
tools.description: The stable identifier of the linked Simple House Planner account.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "query_project" appears informational but accepts parameters (script) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "edit_project" is 27638 chars, far longer than this server's median (181). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
